$comment: How the API describes itself (scripts/openapi.js): its title, where it is served, the ways a caller identifies itself, and which callers each part of the API serves — the first pattern a path matches decides.
title: LUXORA Platform API
description: Every route the platform serves. A store's systems call the admin routes with a store API key as a Bearer token (issued in Store console → AI → API & MCP keys; it acts with one staff role). Shopper routes use the shopper's session cookie. Platform routes need a platform administrator's session. Generated from the code — see docs/api/README.md.

storeKey.description: A store API key (lxm_…): the store's staff, with the key's role

session.name: azs
session.description: A shopper's or staff member's session; writes also send the azc cookie's value as the x-csrf header

400.description: The request cannot be done as asked; the reason is in error

401.description: Not signed in, or the key is invalid or revoked

403.description: The caller's role does not reach this
